title: ISNAD: benchmark data and analysis code for "Accuracy is not reliability" (Information Processing & Management, 2026)
description:
Companion archive for the article Accuracy is not reliability: abstention-aware evaluation of large language models on bio-bibliographic claim verification in classical Islamic scholarship (Information Processing & Management, Elsevier, 2026, in press).

Contents: the ISNAD benchmark (1,986 scored Turkish claims across five probe types) and the 360-item Turkish/Arabic GAL replication set with gold labels; freeze and exclusion manifests; 64,216 raw model-output records; blank expert-study forms with answer keys; and six analysis scripts with fixed seeds that regenerate the article's tables. Item-level expert responses are not released, at the annotator's request.

Licences: code (analysis/) MIT; data (data/, human_studies/) CC BY 4.0. Factual information drawn from the TDV İslâm Ansiklopedisi and from Brockelmann's History of the Arabic Written Tradition; no rights are claimed over those works.
